# Yashana Polymers

> Yashana Polymers is a Delhi, India based manufacturer and supplier of engineering polymer granules — Polycarbonate (PC), ABS and PBT — in natural, opaque and transparent colour-matched grades, packed in batch-coded 25 kg bags. Yashana Polymers is a part of Shri Ganesh Polymer (https://shriganeshpolymer.in/).

## Company
- Name: Yashana Polymers
- Parent company: Shri Ganesh Polymer — https://shriganeshpolymer.in/

## Products
- PC (Polycarbonate) granules / PC dana: high impact strength, optical clarity, heat resistance. Colours include natural white, jet black, sky blue and transparent blue, red, teal and orange; custom shades on request.
- ABS granules: easy moulding, excellent surface finish, good toughness.
- PBT granules: chemical resistance and electrical insulation for electrical components.

## Quality & certifications
- ISO 9001:2015 (Quality Management)
- ISO 14001:2015 (Environmental Management)
- MSME registered (Govt. of India)
- RoHS compliant materials
- In-house testing lab: colour sampling, specimen moulding, notch cutting, dimension check, Melt Flow Index (MFI), impact testing, colour measurement and tensile testing.

## Industries served
Electrical & switchgear, automotive, home appliances, LED & lighting, consumer electronics, industrial & packaging.
